# Pinned to tracebloc-engine's runtime versions so CI validates templates
# against what the fleet actually runs (backend#2658).
#
# Unpinned, CI resolved the latest releases (transformers 5.12.x) while the
# engine pins 5.8.0 — so a template could pass here and be broken on the edge.
# That is not hypothetical: sapiens' LoRA target_modules were written for
# 5.12's attention naming, CI went green, and the template could not be
# constructed on the edge at all (backend#2641).
#
# torch/torchvision come from tracebloc-engine's Dockerfile.base.text.cpu;
# the rest from its use_cases/requirements.txt. Bump these together with the
# engine's pins, never ahead of them.
#
# THAT RULE IS NOW A CHECK, not just this comment (#229). This file is the
# second mirror of the engine's pin (the first is tools/requirements-engine-pin.txt),
# and until #229 no guard looked at it: verify-dumps-engine-pin.yml did not
# name .github/requirements/** in its `paths:`, so a lone bump here fired no
# job, and its drift step had a single `--mirror` pointed at the tools/ copy.
# #227 is the proof — opened by dependabot against this file alone, two minors
# ahead of the engine, all green. Both halves are wired now: a change to this
# file triggers that workflow, and `engine-pin-drift-guard` runs
# tools/check_engine_pin_drift.py against this file as well, so a bump ahead of
# the engine goes red here instead of reaching the edge (backend#2641).
pytest
torch==2.11.0
torchvision==0.26.0
transformers==5.10.1
timm==1.0.26
peft==0.19.1
scipy
